/* AppAdminEmployeeStatusMapper.selectDailyRoster */ SELECT U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', U.SITE_CD, U.NODE_CD) AS nodeNm
, CASE WHEN P.WORK_PLAN_CD IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS hasWorkPlanYn
, A.CHECK_IN_TIME AS checkInTime , A.CHECK_OUT_TIME AS checkOutTime
, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_GPS G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.ATTD_ID = A.ATTD_ID ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isOffsiteYn
, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE LX WHERE LX.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND LX.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND LX.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND LX.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( ( LX.USE_UNIT_TYPE = '00' AND LX.START_DATE <= #{workYmd} AND LX.END_DATE >= #{workYmd} ) OR ( LX.USE_UNIT_TYPE <> '00' AND LX.START_DATE = #{workYmd} ) ) ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isOnLeaveYn
, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(A2.ATTD_ID ORDER BY A2.WORK_SEQ SEPARATOR ',') FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A2 WHERE A2.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND A2.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND A2.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND A2.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND A2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A2.WORK_SEQ IN (1, 2) ) AS attdIds
FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_USER_WORK_PLAN P ON P.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND P.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND P.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND P.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} LEFT JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A ON A.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND A.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND A.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.WORK_SEQ = 1 WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND U.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{safeKeyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\'
ORDER BY U.USER_NM, U.USER_CD

/* AppAdminEmployeeStatusMapper.selectAttdGpsTrail (Attd08Mapper.selectAttdGpsTrail 이식) */ SELECT G.GPS_ID AS gpsId , G.LAT_ENC AS latEnc , G.LON_ENC AS lonEnc , G.LAT AS lat , G.LON AS lon , G.ACCURACY AS accuracy , G.API_CALL_DATE AS apiCallDate , G.API_CALL_TIME AS apiCallTime , G.IS_MOCKED AS isMocked , G.GPS_INFO_TYPE AS gpsInfoType /* S5: 좌표 파기 사유 — 화면이 "철회로 사라짐 / 보존기간 경과 / 원래 없음"을 구분한다. */ , G.GPS_PURGE_REASON_CD AS gpsPurgeReasonCd FROM TB_USER_ATTD_GPS G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND G.ATTD_ID = #{attdId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT M WHERE M.ATTD_ID = #{attdId} AND M.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY G.GPS_INFO_TYPE ASC, G.API_CALL_DATE ASC, G.API_CALL_TIME ASC
